badge.androidText: You have {count} things to check in SHINE

permissions.camera: Allows you to take photos, scan codes and join video calls in the app.
permissions.microphone: Lets you speak care notes instead of typing, and record audio messages.
permissions.photoLibrary: Allows you to choose photos and videos to upload.
permissions.photoLibraryAdd: Allows the app to save images to your photo library.
permissions.location: Allows the app to show content and services near you.
permissions.motion: Allows the app to respond to how you move your device.
